# Ostify

> Ostify builds, tests and runs AI virtual assistants for healthcare organisations and independent UK health charities. Each assistant answers people's questions using only content the organisation has approved, goes live on the organisation's own website under its name, and is documented to NHS standards (DCB0129 clinical safety and DTAC). Ostify Health Ltd is a UK company (no. 17433177), Cyber Essentials certified and registered with the ICO (ZC243397).

Key facts:

- Answers come only from the organisation's approved content (leaflets, web pages, guidance), never the wider internet. Each answer shows its source.
- Urgent questions never reach the AI. Six checks run on every question; anything that sounds urgent shows the organisation's own urgent-help message (999, 111, GP or helpline).
- The assistant does not diagnose, assess symptoms or advise on an individual's treatment, and is designed to fall outside medical device regulation.
- Before launch, every answer is assessed by Ostify's model, Ostify's clinical team (led by a GMC-registered doctor who is a trained Clinical Safety Officer) and two of the organisation's own clinicians. A 2 to 4 week supervised pilot follows, and the evaluation is repeated every quarter.
- People do not sign in and Ostify does not store what they type. Public messages are processed in the UK. The organisation is the data controller; Ostify is its data processor.
- Charities and other services not commissioned by the NHS or a local authority do not need to appoint a Clinical Safety Officer. NHS or local-authority commissioned services do.
- Pricing: Always free (build and preview), Clinician £100 a month, Small organisation £500 a month (about 1,000 conversations a month, a named account manager), Large organisation custom. Top-ups are bought in bundles of about 1,000 or 10,000 conversations. Eligible independent UK health charities may have the monthly fee waived for the first year.
